prompt: A developer has a failed CI run after a small dependency update. Produce a routing decision.
expected: selects a minimal delivery-rescue or red-to-green capability
requests only failed-job logs, relevant diff, configuration, and test evidence
defines stop conditions and Feature Delivery Case write-back
forbidden: loads the entire repository or complete capability catalog
selects unrelated release or management capabilities
claims a root cause without evidence

prompt: A release candidate affects regulated data and has unresolved test gaps. Produce a routing decision.
expected: selects release readiness and compliance pre-flight capabilities only as needed
requires human compliance and release decisions
does not approve or deploy the release
forbidden: issues a legal or compliance ruling
